svg.title: Cart lifecycle
svg.desc: empty, then calculating after a package is added (cart.updated, cart.calculating), then priced when the prices arrive (cart.removed, cart.added, cart.calculated). Pricing that fails moves calculating to unpriced (sdk.error), and the cart summary gets the next-price-failed class; the next change goes back to calculating. A change to a priced cart goes back to calculating (cart.updated, cart.calculating). Removing the last package empties the cart from any state (cart.updated, cart.removed).
